conventions: grid second bin = floor of absolute clock time (not time since first row); relative flooring shifts run boundaries by 1 s
speed-zone TOTAL native rows require valid speed AND valid (ffilled) rpm; engine-on counts require rpm>400
speed = [VCM] Vehicle Speed column when drive_master speed_source=vcm, else OBD speed (older vcm drives mismatched otherwise)
native ffill limit 15 rows gives 16 rows per sample; boost negatives stay in n (valid = non-NaN) but maxBoost is floored at 0.0

hvc null and empty turbo dicts when no engine-on row has valid boost (3 drives); first guess variants (relative flooring, negative->NaN) were wrong and discarded; numbers given are after resolving conventions from the claim, so agreement is convention-calibrated on the 26-drive sample, not fully blind

intervalReproduced.method: seed 42, 4000 draws, day-clustered percentile, ratio of sums
